items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon
items.summary: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，官方称其面向复杂软件工程、知识工作和科学流程提供前沿级能力，支持 1 million-token 上下文。模型已在 Gemini API、Google AI Studio、Gemini for business 以及 Gemini app 的付费订阅用户中逐步开放，输入每百万 token 定价 $3、输出每百万 token 定价 $15。

evidence.quote: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.

Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out today in the Gemini API in Google AI Studio , Gemini for business (via API and model dropdown), for paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity , and for Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app .

items.title: Anthropic 称 Claude 解决两个黑洞物理开放问题
items.summary: Anthropic 表示 Claude 完成了理论物理中的两个开放问题：其一是物理学家二十多年前提出但一直未完成的 Hawking-Page 相变计算，其二是模块化 bootstrap 中最简单版本技术的精确上限。两个结果都以预印本公开，并在 September 于 Lean 中得到形式化验证。

evidence.quote: Related articles Science Nov 4, 2026 Investigating vault particles with Claude View more Claude has solved two open problems in theoretical physics.
In the first, it completed a calculation that physicists set up more than 20 years ago, but which had never been solved.
In the second, Claude found the exact limit of the simplest version of a technique used to test candidate theories of quantum gravity.
The preprints are available here and here .
Claude did it by running a small research group of copies of itself, in which it worked out almost every piece of the calculation independently and checked its math against known results.
In September, the results were formally verified in Lean, a computerized proof checker.

items.title: RadixArk 开源 DaisyRose-27B 长程 Agent 模型
items.summary: RadixArk 发布 DaisyRose-27B，基于 Qwen3.8-27B 并使用 Miles 进行强化学习训练，官方报告 Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 从 5.6% 提升到 12.0%。模型保留 256K-token 上下文并以 Apache 2.0 发布，官方建议使用 SGLang 与 DSpark speculative decoding 进行部署。

evidence.quote: Today we are releasing DaisyRose-27B , RadixArk’s first model, built on Qwen3.8-27B and trained with reinforcement learning using Miles .
We trained it on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, with just 1,200 curated tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs.
DaisyRose-27B improves Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 from 5.6% to 12.0% .
The checkpoints are available under Apache 2.0 :
The model retains Qwen3.8-27B’s architecture, tokenizer, chat template, image understanding, and 256K-token context window .
We recommend serving DaisyRose-27B with SGLang and DSpark speculative decoding.

items.title: Reson8 开源 0.5B 多语种语音识别模型 Rumble-2-Flash
items.summary: Reson8 以 Apache 2.0 开源 Rumble-2-Flash，这是一款支持 40+ 种语言的 0.5B 参数语音识别模型，原生支持 Transformers 与 vLLM，无需自定义代码。在 Open ASR Leaderboard 多语种赛道平均错误率为 6.96%，在 302 小时的呼叫中心基准上 WER 为 7.86%，与 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) 相当。

evidence.quote: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
Today we're open sourcing Rumble-2-Flash under the Apache 2.0 license.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.
Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code
Rumble-2-Flash uses the Qwen3-ASR architecture for day-0 support.
On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.

On AppTek's call-centre benchmark (302 hours of helpline calls, 14 English accents, scored with AppTek's own script), Rumble-2-Flash reaches 7.86% WER , on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) at 7.78%.

items.title: AscendGYM：面向真实负载的昇腾算子优化基准
items.summary: AscendGYM 提供面向 Ascend NPU 的算子优化评测基准，首批包含 48 个不同难度的算子，测试数据来自真实训练与推理任务。它支持模型评测与模型-框架评测两种模式，并提出兼顾加速比与 token 成本的 Speedup-Token Score (STS) 指标。

evidence.quote: Papers arxiv:2611.17621 Copy markdown AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs Published on Nov 13 · Submitted by Dongfang Li on Nov 18 #2 Paper of the day · SLAI-AITP Upvote 91 +83 Authors: AI Training Platform Team , Bingwei Zhang , Jing Li , Am
benchmark for assessing kernel optimization capabilities on Ascend NPUs using real-workload test cases, two evaluation modes, and a Speedup-Token Score that balances speedup against token cost.
To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels.
Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks.
In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation .
Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS) , which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost .
AscendGYM is available at https://github.com/SLAI-AITP/AscendGYM.

items.title: Multi-Branch Transformer：并行分支扩展语言模型
items.summary: Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT) 让输入先经过共享的初始层，再并行执行独立参数的 Transformer 分支并在共享的末层前融合。论文报告在 0.8B 到 2.1B 总参数的 MoE 预训练中，2-branch Wide-Shallow MBT 持续优于同等参数与训练算力的串行 Transformer，KV cache 存储最多减少 34%，单张 H200 上解码吞吐最高提升 51.4%。

evidence.quote: Papers arxiv:2611.19800 Copy markdown Multi-Branch Transformer Published on Nov 15 · Submitted by Gaotang Li on Nov 18 Upvote 45 +37 Authors: Gaotang Li , Lingjie Chen , Chunyuan Deng , Zhiwei Xu , Hongzheng Chen , Christopher De Sa , Jingrui He , Yingheng Wang , Hanghang Tong Abstract Branching Tra

We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT) , which processes the input through shared initial layers , executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers .

In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets.
To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV , which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth.
Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss .
These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU.

items.title: RepoFactory：把代码仓库转成可验证训练环境
items.summary: RepoFactory 自动把真实软件仓库转换为可验证环境，Agent 依据语言规范从零构建完整项目，并通过 Environment Evolution Loop 用代理反馈优化环境。论文报告产出 10,159 个覆盖 17 个软件领域的环境，训练得到的 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B 在 NL2Repo-Bench 上比 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 提升 22.6 个百分点。

evidence.quote: Papers arxiv:2611.21152 Copy markdown From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop Published on Nov 17 · Submitted by Jian Yang on Nov 18 · IQuest Upvote 12 +4 Authors: Yang Tian , Tianyu Zheng , Xiyuan Yang , Yaxin Du , Chengran Yang
We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification .
Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling , and implementation scope through proxy feedback .
RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains.
Ultimately, we constructed 10,159 environments covering 17 software domains.
RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, trained on these environments, improves by 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench compared with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and by 8.5 percentage points on average across five benchmarks.

items.title: Self-Improvement Memory 支持持续递归自我改进
items.summary: Google 等机构提出 Self-Improvement Memory (SIM)，为 harness 优化器记录每次修改的理由、预测与实际结果以及评测上下文，使优化历史可跨基准或策略模型延续。论文在四个领域的跨数据集与跨模型对比中均取得更高最终分数，十次独立的编码任务续跑中平均比仅保留 harness 的续跑高出 2.36 分（p=0.003）。

evidence.quote: Papers arxiv:2611.18856 Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement Published on Nov 13 · Submitted by Xin lucas-Yu on Nov 18 · Google Upvote 31 +23 Authors: Xin Yu , Fei Xia , Jiaqi Pan , Youbao Tang , Chengzhi Liu , Adams Yu , Sicong Jiang , Yanfei Chen , Lingzhou Xue , Ti
We propose Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer , rather than the task-solving policy .
SIM groups edits by recurring harness problem and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context.
In our experiments across four domains, SIM achieves higher final scores than harness-only and root-cause-only continuation in cross-dataset and pairwise cross-model comparisons .
Across ten independent source runs in coding, paired continuations with SIM improve final scores by an average of 2.36 points over harness-only continuation (p=0.003).
SIM finishes ahead in nine pairs, with a mean gain of 2.36 score points (95% CI: 1.05–3.68; p = 0.003).

items.title: Transformers 支持从 SSD 流式加载 MoE 专家权重

evidence.quote: Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it
Added "onFailure": "block" for mcp_tool hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action

Fixed Code Mode stopping a script when a permission prompt outside auto or bypass mode, a plan approval or a question stayed open for ten minutes

evidence.quote: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
Now, we’re bringing the Gemini app to eligible Android (Go edition) devices , putting Google’s personal AI assistant in the hands of hundreds of millions more people.
